app.name: Kola
app.tagline: Save together. Everyone pays, or everyone gets their money back.
onboarding.title: Welcome to Kola
onboarding.body: Save with your group. Everyone pays their share, or everyone gets their money back.
pin.label: PIN
pin.createHelp: You will use it to open Kola on this phone. Nobody can recover it for you, so pick one you will remember.
pin.mismatch: The two PINs are different. Please start again.
pin.invalid: Your PIN must be exactly 6 digits.
unlock.title: Enter your PIN
unlock.wait: Too many tries. Please wait {seconds} seconds.
receive.title: Receive money
receive.show: Show this code to the person paying you, or copy it and send it to them.
pay.title: Pay
pay.confirmAmount: You are about to pay {amount} sats.
pay.inFlight: Your payment is still being delivered. Check your activity in a minute before trying again.
errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.moneyStill: Your money is still in your wallet.
errors.moneyUnknown: We could not confirm whether the payment went through. Check your activity before you try again.
errors.unauthorized: We could not confirm it is you. Check that your phone's date and time are correct, then try again.
errors.invalid_request: Something in the request was not right. Please check and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.no_wallet: Your wallet is not set up yet.
errors.no_wallet_available: All test wallets on this server are in use. Try one of the demo people instead, or ask the organizer to reset the demo.
errors.wallet_unavailable: Your wallet cannot be reached right now. Please try again shortly.
errors.invalid_invoice: This does not look like a payment request.
errors.wrong_network: This payment request is for a different network and cannot be paid here.
errors.no_amount: This payment request has no amount. Ask for one that includes the amount.
errors.wrong_amount: The amount is not the one expected.
errors.expired: This payment request has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.over_payment_cap: This is more than the limit for a single payment.
errors.over_daily_cap: This would go over today's spending limit.
errors.payment_failed: The payment did not go through.
errors.payment_status_unknown: We lost contact with your wallet during the payment.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
errors.circle_not_found: We could not find that circle. Check the code and try again.
errors.not_a_member: You are not a member of this circle.
errors.not_creator: Only the person who created the circle can do this.
errors.circle_not_ready: The circle is still waiting for members to join.
errors.cycle_in_progress: A round is already in progress.
errors.circle_complete: Everyone in this circle has already received the pot.
errors.no_open_cycle: There is no round to pay into right now.
circles.title: Your savings circles
circles.empty: You are not in a circle yet. Start one with people you trust, or join one with a code.
create.title: Start a circle
create.name: Circle name
create.nicknameHelp: The others in the circle will see this. Use a nickname, not your full name.
create.potPreview: Each round, one person receives {amount} sats.
join.title: Join a circle
circle.invite: Share this code with the people you invite:
circle.inviteMessage: Join my savings circle "{name}" on Kola: {amount} sats each round, paid out to one of us in turn. Open {url}, create your wallet, then in Circles tap "Join with a code" and enter {code}.
circle.members: Members, in the order they receive
circle.shareHeld: Your share is set aside. If not everyone pays in time, it comes back to you automatically.
circle.sharePending: Your payment is on its way. This page will update in a moment.
circle.notReady: The first round can start once everyone has joined.
circle.waitOrganizer: Waiting for the organizer to start the next round.
circle.complete: Everyone has received the pot. This circle is complete.
circle.state.settling: Everyone has paid. Sending the pot…
circle.state.paying_out: Everyone has paid. Sending the pot to {name}. If it takes a while, it is retried automatically.
circle.state.cancelled: This round was cancelled because not everyone paid in time. Everyone who paid got their money back.
backup.title: Back up your wallet
backup.explain: Your backup code lets you use Kola on a new phone if this one is lost. It only works together with your PIN. Save it somewhere private, and never share your PIN.
restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.wrong: The backup code or the PIN is not right.
audit.title: Public record
audit.explain: Every step of this circle is recorded and signed, so nobody can quietly change what happened. Your phone checks each signature itself.
audit.unreachable: The public record cannot be reached right now. Your money is not affected. Please try again.
audit.allGood: All {count} records are genuine and agree with each other.
audit.problems: This record has problems. Talk to your group before paying more.
audit.problem.bad_signature: A record has been altered: its signature does not match.
audit.problem.wrong_signer: A record was signed by someone who should not have signed it.
audit.problem.malformed: A record could not be read.
audit.problem.no_definition: The circle's rules are missing from the record.
audit.problem.unjoined_member: A member has not yet signed their agreement to the rules. This clears once they open the circle.
audit.problem.hash_mismatch: A payment does not match the one announced when the round opened.
audit.problem.preimage_mismatch: A proof of payment does not match its payment.
audit.problem.wrong_recipient: The pot went to someone other than the person whose turn it was.
audit.problem.wrong_amount: The pot paid out is not the full amount.
audit.problem.payout_before_settled: A pot was recorded as paid before everyone's share was collected.
audit.problem.settled_after_cancel: Money was collected in a round recorded as cancelled.
audit.entry.circle_defined: Rules and order of the circle recorded
audit.entry.cycle_cancelled: Round {n} cancelled, everyone refunded. Did not pay: {names}
errors.assistant_unavailable: The assistant can't answer right now. The quick questions above still work.
assistant.title: Questions about this circle
assistant.aiNote: Answers come from an AI assistant that can only read this circle. It can make mistakes and can never move money.
assistant.templatedNote: Answers come from what this circle shows right now.
answer.turnCurrent: {name} receives the pot this round ({amount} sats).
answer.turnNext: No round is running. Next to receive: {name}, in round {n}.
answer.turnDone: Everyone has received the pot. This circle is complete.
answer.owesNoRound: No round is running, so nobody needs to pay right now.
answer.reminder: Hello {names}! Round {n} of our circle "{circle}" is open. Please pay your share of {amount} sats in Kola before the deadline ({time} left). If not everyone pays in time, everyone gets their money back automatically. Thank you!
answer.reminderNone: Nobody needs a reminder right now.
settings.title: Settings
settings.currencyHelp: Approximate value shown next to sats
settings.backupHelp: Lets you open this wallet on another phone.
settings.lockHelp: Ask for your PIN again right now.
settings.about: Kola is open source. This version runs on a test network: the money in it is not real.
welcome.title: Save together, safely
welcome.body: Run your tontine from your phone. No cash to carry, and nobody can run off with the pot.
welcome.b1: Your share is only set aside until everyone has paid.
welcome.b2: If someone doesn't pay in time, all shares go back automatically.
welcome.b3Title: Every step is on the record
welcome.b3: Each payment is signed and public, so there are no arguments about who paid.
demo.title: Try the demo
demo.body: Open Kola as a member of a test circle. Test money only.
pay.help: Ask the person you are paying for their payment request, then paste it here.
create.potExplain: {people} people take turns, one round each.
join.explain: Ask the organizer for the 6-character circle code.
settings.demoHelp: Play each member’s part from this one phone or browser. Switching takes a few seconds.
